notes.title: [CLOSED BETA] Update v0.1.1

notes.title: [CLOSED BETA] Update v0.0.5
notes.content:
[h3][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixes slight jitter occurring for synchronized movement
[*] Fixes invincibility after respawn
[*] Fixes movement desync after respawn
[*] Fixes endurance being wasted when pressing Shift key but not moving

notes.title: [CLOSED BETA] Update v0.0.4
notes.content:

[/list]

notes.title: V0.0.3 Update
notes.content:
[u][b]Features[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] New character controller system
[*] New input system with partial gamepad support
[*] New camera system
[*] Dynamic foot placement system
[*] Added discord integration
[/list]

[u][b]Changes[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Improved character's physics performance
[*] Improved running animation
[*] Improved muzzle flash effect
[*] Jump isn't possible anymore during land roll
[*] Reduced bandwidth usage by ~10%
[*] Reduced ranged weapon's recoil
[/list]

[u][b]Bug fixes
[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixes a bug where current weapon isn't reloaded at respawn (for real this time)
[*] Fixes the character being stuck by a stair while walking
[*] Fixes character collider height not being updated when land rolling
[*] Fixes rolling animation being not synced 
[/list]
